title: R-Diverse: Mitigating Diversity Illusion in Self-Play LLM Training
authors_zh: Gengsheng Li、Jinghan He、Shijie Wang、Ruiqi Liu、Renrui Zhang、Zijun Yao、Junfeng Fang、Haiyun Guo、Dan Zhang、Jinqiao Wang
paper_type_zh: 记忆增强推理自博弈方法
best_for_zh: 关注自博弈课程、多样性度量、经验回放与数据审计的研究者
one_line: Adds skill-aware historical diversity penalties and replay to Challenger-Solver self-play, but releases no executable pipeline or generated records.
为 Challenger-Solver 自博弈加入程序级技能多样性和历史记忆惩罚，但未发布可执行流程或生成记录。
why: Shows how within-batch lexical novelty can hide repeated reasoning procedures and how persistent memory changes both the generated curriculum and its audit surface.
inclusion_reason: Makes persistent memory and a program-level similarity proxy explicit controls in self-play reasoning-data construction while exposing pseudo-label and release risks.

title: Problem
问题
html:
Self-play reasoning systems turn model-generated questions and solutions into the next round of training data. In the R-Zero-style Challenger-Solver loop studied here, the Challenger is rewarded for posing questions near the Solver's uncertainty boundary, while a within-iteration repetition term is intended to keep the curriculum varied. The paper argues that local lexical novelty is insufficient: later rounds can recycle earlier modes, and differently worded questions can exercise nearly identical procedures. It calls these failures Local Diversity Illusion and Surface Diversity Illusion. (Paper §1 and §3.)

The constructed object is not a static benchmark. It is an evolving stream of generated competition-math questions, Solver reasoning rollouts and extracted answers, equivalence groups, consistency scores, majority pseudo-labels, canonical Python representations, embeddings, memory decisions, and replayed historical question-answer pairs. The policy, pseudo-label source, novelty representation, and historical pool all change during training. No immutable copy of this stream is released.

This is a data-construction paper because MAP and SAM alter which questions are rewarded, admitted to memory, and replayed. It is not a ground-truth dataset release: its principal correctness signal remains Solver agreement, while the official repository currently exposes a project description and figures rather than executable code or generated records.

自博弈推理系统会把模型生成的问题与解答转化为下一轮训练数据。在本文研究的 R-Zero 式 Challenger-Solver 循环中，Challenger 因生成接近 Solver 不确定性边界的问题而获得奖励，轮内重复惩罚则用于维持课程多样性。论文指出，局部词面新颖性并不充分：后续轮次可能重复历史模式，措辞不同的问题也可能训练近乎相同的求解过程。论文将这两种失效称为 Local Diversity Illusion 与 Surface Diversity Illusion。（论文 §1、§3。）

这里构造的对象不是静态 benchmark，而是持续演化的数据流：竞赛数学问题、Solver reasoning rollout 与提取答案、答案等价组、consistency、多数投票伪标签、规范化 Python 表示、embedding、记忆判定，以及回放的历史问答对。训练过程中，policy、伪标签来源、新颖性表示与历史池都会变化。论文没有发布这条数据流的 immutable snapshot。

MAP 与 SAM 会改变哪些题目得到奖励、进入记忆并被回放，因此该工作属于数据构造研究。但它不是 ground-truth dataset release：主要正确性信号仍来自 Solver 自身的一致性，官方仓库目前也只是项目说明与图片，并未提供可执行代码或生成记录。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html:
R-Diverse adds two controls to the R-Zero-style loop. Memory-Augmented Penalty (MAP) keeps a persistent bank of prior valid questions and penalizes a new question's maximum similarity to any history item and its mean similarity to the bank. The same memory supplies historical question-answer pairs for Solver replay. Skill-Aware Measurement (SAM) changes the comparison space: Qwen2.5-Coder-7B maps each question to a canonical Python solver function, and Jina-Code-Embeddings-1.5B embeds that code for cosine comparison. (Paper §3.2–§3.3.)

The feedback contract remains partly self-referential. For each question, five Solver answers are grouped by equivalence. If the largest group's share is s, Challenger uncertainty is min(s, 1-s), which is largest near a split vote; the largest group also supplies the pseudo-label. Challenger reward subtracts within-iteration and memory-aware similarity penalties from uncertainty. A Solver response receives binary reward for matching the pseudo-label. MAP and SAM therefore reshape curriculum difficulty and novelty, but they do not add an independent truth verifier.

There are three distinct feedback roles that should not be conflated: uncertainty targets questions near current Solver competence, SAM/MAP discourage procedural recycling, and the majority pseudo-label supervises Solver answers. GPT-4o appears in answer rechecking and paper-side diversity/curriculum analyses; the paper does not specify enough training-time coverage to reinterpret the whole loop as externally verified.

R-Diverse 在 R-Zero 式循环中加入两项控制。Memory-Augmented Penalty（MAP）持久保存历史有效问题，并依据新问题与任一历史项的最大相似度、以及与整个记忆库的平均相似度施加惩罚；同一记忆库还向 Solver 提供历史问答对用于 replay。Skill-Aware Measurement（SAM）则改变比较空间：Qwen2.5-Coder-7B 把问题映射为规范化 Python solver function，Jina-Code-Embeddings-1.5B 再编码程序并计算余弦相似度。（论文 §3.2–§3.3。）

反馈契约仍然部分自指。每个问题产生五个 Solver 答案并按等价关系分组；若最大组占比为 s，Challenger uncertainty 为 min(s, 1-s)，在投票接近分裂时最高；最大组同时提供伪标签。Challenger reward 从 uncertainty 中扣除轮内与记忆感知的相似度惩罚；Solver response 是否匹配伪标签决定二元 reward。MAP 与 SAM 改变了课程难度和新颖性，却没有加入独立 truth verifier。

三类反馈角色必须分开理解：uncertainty 让题目贴近当前 Solver 能力边界，SAM/MAP 抑制求解过程重复，多数投票伪标签监督 Solver 答案。GPT-4o 用于答案复核以及论文中的多样性、课程分析；论文没有充分交代其训练时覆盖范围，不能据此把整个循环解释为外部验证流程。

title: Method
方法
html:
Both Challenger and Solver start from Qwen3-4B-Base or Qwen3-8B-Base and are optimized with GRPO in EasyR1. The disclosed Challenger prompt requests one brand-new competition-math problem, aimed below a 30% solve rate for advanced high-school students, plus a boxed final answer; no seed corpus is disclosed. The reported run has five evolution iterations, each with 5 Challenger and 15 Solver optimization steps. Global batch size is 128, learning rate is 1e-6, and weight decay and KL coefficient are 1e-2. (Paper §4.1; Appendix A.1–A.2.)

For each question the Solver produces five rollouts. Extracted final answers are partitioned into equivalence groups; consistency is the largest group's fraction, and uncertainty is min(s, 1-s). The majority answer becomes the pseudo-label, and a Solver rollout receives binary reward for matching it. The paper illustrates a valid uncertainty interval of 0.3 to 0.8 for memory insertion. It discloses a GPT-4o Yes/No answer-check prompt, but not its exact placement, sampling coverage, fallback behavior, or interaction with equivalence grouping.

SAM asks Qwen2.5-Coder-7B at temperature 0 to convert a question into a comment-free solver function, move numerical values into default arguments, and anonymize semantic variables. Its prompt explicitly says to infer the intended valid interpretation when the question is ambiguous, flawed, or poorly phrased. Jina-Code-Embeddings-1.5B encodes the result. The code is used as a similarity representation; the paper does not report executing it as a verifier.

MAP combines nearest-memory and mean-memory cosine similarity, with mixing coefficient 0.5, max and mean activation thresholds 0.5 and 0.25, and penalty weights 1.0. Accepted memory tuples retain the question, embedding, and pseudo-label; historical pairs provide 30% of Solver training examples. Challenger training uses four rollouts and Solver training five, both at temperature 1.0 and top-p 0.99.

Experiments use eight NVIDIA H20 GPUs with BF16 and FlashAttention 2. The paper reports about six hours for one Qwen3-4B evolution iteration after time-multiplexing optimization, versus 7.5 hours for its R-Zero comparison. Total run cost, token counts, 8B timing, random seeds, exact answer-equivalence code, memory capacity and eviction, correction policy, and record counts are not disclosed. The official repository does not supply the implementation or records needed to rerun the recipe.

Challenger 与 Solver 均从 Qwen3-4B-Base 或 Qwen3-8B-Base 初始化，并在 EasyR1 中使用 GRPO 优化。公开的 Challenger prompt 要求生成一道全新的竞赛数学题，目标难度是高级高中生解出率低于 30%，同时给出 boxed final answer；论文未披露 seed corpus。报告的训练共五轮 evolution iteration，每轮包含 5 个 Challenger 与 15 个 Solver optimization step。Global batch size 为 128，learning rate 为 1e-6，weight decay 与 KL coefficient 均为 1e-2。（论文 §4.1；Appendix A.1–A.2。）

每个问题产生五个 Solver rollout。提取的最终答案按等价关系分组，最大组占比定义 consistency，uncertainty 为 min(s, 1-s)。多数答案成为伪标签，Solver rollout 是否匹配它决定二元 reward。论文以 consistency 0.3 至 0.8 说明可进入记忆的有效 uncertainty 区间。附录公开了 GPT-4o Yes/No answer-check prompt，但没有说明它在流程中的精确位置、抽样覆盖、失败回退方式，以及与答案等价分组的关系。

SAM 以 temperature 0 请求 Qwen2.5-Coder-7B 把问题转换为无注释的 solver function，将数值放入默认参数并匿名化语义变量。该 prompt 明确要求：遇到含糊、有逻辑缺陷或措辞不佳的问题时，自行推断其预期的有效解释。Jina-Code-Embeddings-1.5B 对结果编码。这里的代码只是相似度表示；论文没有报告执行代码来验证答案。

MAP 组合最近历史项与全记忆平均余弦相似度，混合系数为 0.5，最大与平均相似度激活阈值为 0.5 和 0.25，各惩罚权重为 1.0。被接收的记忆 tuple 保存问题、embedding 与伪标签；历史问答对占 Solver 训练样本的 30%。Challenger training 使用四个 rollout，Solver training 使用五个，均采用 temperature 1.0 与 top-p 0.99。

实验使用八张 NVIDIA H20 GPU、BF16 与 FlashAttention 2。论文报告经 time-multiplexing 优化后，Qwen3-4B 每轮 evolution iteration 约六小时；其 R-Zero 对照为 7.5 小时。总成本、token 数、8B 时长、random seed、答案等价实现、记忆容量与淘汰、纠错策略、记录数量均未披露。官方仓库也未提供复现 recipe 所需的实现与数据记录。

title: Evidence
证据
html:
Across seven mathematical and three general-reasoning benchmarks, Table 1 reports that five-iteration R-Diverse raises Math AVG from 42.58 to 52.59 for Qwen3-4B-Base and from 49.18 to 56.46 for Qwen3-8B-Base. Three-iteration variants score 50.68 and 55.40. Overall AVG moves from 27.10 to 36.68 for 4B and from 34.49 to 40.75 for 8B. Evaluation is greedy pass@1 except AMC and AIME, which use mean@32. These results measure trained models under the authors' protocol; they do not verify every generated question, pseudo-label, code abstraction, or replay record. (Paper Table 1, §4.1.)

The Qwen3-4B ablation reports Math AVG 52.59 for the full method, 49.62 without MAP, 51.18 without memory replay, and 50.50 without SAM. Removing the max and mean MAP terms together gives 49.88; removing representation abstraction gives 50.79, while replacing embedding-based similarity gives 51.05. These comparisons support that the named components affect the reported outcome, but do not separate record quality from optimizer dynamics or establish statistical reliability because seeds and repeated-run variance are absent. (Paper Table 2.)

The paper also measures the proposed failure mode. For R-Diverse, the GPT-4o duplicate ratio over top-3 retrieved historical neighbors falls from 59% to 53%, while Challenger entropy rises from 0.64 to 0.94; R-Zero's duplicate ratio rises from 71% to 84%. Five 200-question iteration sets receive GPT-4o ground-truth labels, and the preceding Solver's pass rate on its target set stays near the intended 50% region, from 47.5% to 50.5% across the diagonal. These are mechanism-aligned analyses, but SAM embeddings and GPT-4o judgments remain proxies, not released record-level correctness evidence. (Paper §5.3–§5.4, Figure 4, Table 3.)

Artifact evidence is much weaker. The official GitHub repository was rechecked on 2026-07-22: it shows one commit, a README, and figures, with no implementation, generated data, model weights, memory bank, LICENSE, tags, or releases. The README's release plan is prospective. Consequently the accepted metadata remains status: partial and artifact_verified: false despite the paper-level experimental evidence.

Table 1 在七个数学与三个通用推理 benchmark 上报告：五轮 R-Diverse 将 Qwen3-4B-Base 的 Math AVG 从 42.58 提升到 52.59，将 Qwen3-8B-Base 从 49.18 提升到 56.46；三轮版本分别为 50.68 与 55.40。Overall AVG 在 4B 上从 27.10 变为 36.68，在 8B 上从 34.49 变为 40.75。除 AMC 与 AIME 使用 mean@32 外，评测采用 greedy pass@1。这些结果衡量作者协议下的训练模型，不能验证每个生成问题、伪标签、代码抽象或回放记录。（论文 Table 1、§4.1。）

Qwen3-4B 消融中，完整方法的 Math AVG 为 52.59，去除 MAP 后为 49.62，去除 memory replay 后为 51.18，去除 SAM 后为 50.50；同时去除 MAP 的最大与平均相似度项得到 49.88，去除 representation abstraction 得到 50.79，去除 embedding-based similarity 得到 51.05。这些比较支持各组件会影响报告结果，却不能把 record quality 与 optimizer dynamics 分离；论文没有报告 seed 与多次运行方差，也不能据此断言统计稳定性。（论文 Table 2。）

论文也测量了所提出的失效模式。R-Diverse 中，GPT-4o 对 top-3 历史近邻给出的 duplicate ratio 从 59% 降至 53%，Challenger entropy 从 0.64 升至 0.94；R-Zero 的 duplicate ratio 则从 71% 升至 84%。五轮各抽取 200 道题并用 GPT-4o 生成 ground-truth label，前一轮 Solver 在对应目标集合上的通过率沿对角线保持在预期的 50% 附近，范围为 47.5% 至 50.5%。这些分析与机制对齐，但 SAM embedding 与 GPT-4o judgment 仍是代理，而非公开的 record-level correctness evidence。（论文 §5.3–§5.4、Figure 4、Table 3。）

Artifact 证据明显更弱。2026-07-22 再次检查官方 GitHub 仓库时，页面仍显示一个 commit、README 与图片，没有实现、生成数据、model weight、memory bank、LICENSE、tag 或 release。README 中的 release plan 只是未来计划。因此，即使论文实验已有结果，accepted metadata 仍应保持 status: partial 与 artifact_verified: false。

title: Novelty
新意
html:
Relative to R-Zero, the concrete change is to make diversity control both history-aware and procedure-aware. MAP uses persistent memory as a repulsive regularizer across iterations and reuses the same history for Solver replay. SAM maps natural-language questions through canonical solver code before computing similarity. Together they distinguish lexical novelty from novelty in the procedures exercised by the Solver. (Paper §3.2–§3.3.)

The Challenger-Solver loop, GRPO, uncertainty curriculum, majority pseudo-labeling, experience replay, code generation, embeddings, and LLM judges are not new individually. The paper's contribution is the diagnosis of Local and Surface Diversity Illusions and the placement of MAP and SAM inside the data-production loop. Its ablation and diversity measurements are aligned with that diagnosis.

The boundary matters: SAM is a data-selection and reward proxy, not program execution or a correctness verifier. MAP preserves history and discourages revisiting it, but does not make stored labels reliable. The novelty is therefore a construction control for an evolving curriculum, not a new source of ground-truth supervision or a completed open-data release.

相较于 R-Zero，R-Diverse 的具体变化是让多样性控制同时感知历史与求解过程。MAP 把持久记忆作为跨迭代的排斥正则，并用同一历史为 Solver 提供 replay；SAM 先把自然语言问题映射为规范化 solver code，再计算相似度。二者共同区分词面新颖性与 Solver 实际练习的求解过程新颖性。（论文 §3.2–§3.3。）

Challenger-Solver 循环、GRPO、uncertainty curriculum、多数投票伪标签、experience replay、代码生成、embedding 与 LLM judge 都不是单独由本文提出。论文贡献在于诊断 Local 与 Surface Diversity Illusion，并把 MAP、SAM 嵌入数据生产循环；消融和多样性测量也与这一诊断相对应。

边界同样重要：SAM 是数据选择与 reward 代理，不是程序执行或 correctness verifier。MAP 保留历史并抑制重复探索，却不能让存入记忆的标签自动变得可靠。因此，真正的新意是对演化课程的构造控制，而不是新的 ground-truth supervision 来源或已经完成的开放数据发布。

title: Limitations
局限
html:
The main correctness signal is a self-generated majority pseudo-label. A Solver can agree on a wrong answer, and replay can preserve that error across iterations. The paper does not disclose answer canonicalization, equivalence grouping, ties, malformed-output handling, or policies for correcting or deleting bad memory entries. Memory capacity, eviction, versioning, rejected-record counts, and a transition ledger are also unknown.

SAM is an uncalibrated proxy for skill equivalence. Its canonicalizer is explicitly instructed to infer an intended valid interpretation for ambiguous or flawed questions, so the representation can silently change the task. The generated code is not reported as being executed. Embedding similarity may merge different skills or separate equivalent ones, and thresholds are not calibrated against expert labels. A code bottleneck may also fail in domains that are difficult to formalize. (Paper Appendix A.2 and limitation discussion.)

GPT-4o supplies an answer recheck prompt, duplicate judgments, and labels for the five 200-question analysis sets, but exact model revision, decoding, adjudication, coverage, and error rates are unknown. Benchmark experiments report no seeds, repeated-run variance, generated-record counts, or systematic decontamination. Describing recent AIME items as likely uncontaminated is not an item-level overlap audit.

Reproducibility remains partial. The official repository has no training or inference code, data, weights, memory snapshots, environment lockfile, tagged release, or LICENSE. The paper gives eight-H20 hardware and a 4B per-iteration time, but not full compute, token counts, 8B costs, or long-run memory scaling. Benchmark improvements therefore cannot establish record correctness, data quality, or release completeness.

主要正确性信号是模型自身产生的多数投票伪标签。Solver 可能对错误答案达成一致，replay 还会让错误跨迭代保留。论文没有披露答案规范化、等价分组、平局、异常输出处理，也没有说明如何纠正或删除错误记忆条目。记忆容量、淘汰、版本化、被拒记录数量与 transition ledger 同样未知。

SAM 是未经校准的技能等价代理。其规范化器被明确要求在问题含糊或有缺陷时推断一个预期的有效解释，因此表示过程可能静默改变任务。论文没有报告执行生成代码。Embedding similarity 可能合并不同技能，也可能拆分等价技能，阈值也未用专家标签校准。对于难以形式化的领域，code bottleneck 还可能失效。（论文 Appendix A.2 与限制讨论。）

GPT-4o 提供答案复核 prompt、duplicate judgment，以及五个每轮 200 题分析集合的标签，但其精确模型 revision、decoding、adjudication、覆盖率与错误率未知。Benchmark 实验没有报告 seed、多次运行方差、生成记录数量或系统性 decontamination。把近期 AIME 题描述为“可能未污染”并不等于 item-level overlap audit。

复现性仍然有限。官方仓库没有 training/inference code、数据、权重、memory snapshot、环境 lockfile、tagged release 或 LICENSE。论文只给出八张 H20 硬件和 4B 单轮耗时，没有完整 compute、token 数、8B 成本与长期记忆扩展分析。因此，benchmark 提升不能证明记录正确、data quality 或 release completeness。

title: Usefulness
用途
html:
For the Data Construction and Open Release Recipes track, R-Diverse is a concrete recipe for auditing diversity across rounds rather than only deduplicating the current batch. It places persistent memory at three construction points: a history-aware Challenger penalty, a retrieval surface for diversity measurement, and a replay source for Solver training. It also demonstrates why novelty representation and correctness verification must be audited separately.

An auditable implementation should retain each question, all Solver rollouts, extracted and normalized answers, equivalence groups, consistency, pseudo-label source, canonical code, canonicalizer and embedding revisions, max and mean memory similarity, threshold decisions, memory insert/correct/delete events, replay provenance, reward components, random seed, policy checkpoint, and evaluation outcome. Rejected, malformed, and corrected records should remain visible rather than being silently removed.

Builders can use the paper as a baseline for cross-iteration deduplication, curriculum replay, or data-selection ablations. Before training reuse, they should add an independent correctness check; calibrate SAM against human, symbolic, or executable judgments; version memory snapshots; bound or index retrieval cost; run contamination checks and multiple seeds; and keep benchmark outcomes separate from training-record labels.

The current reuse boundary is recipe reading and independent reimplementation, not direct dataset reuse. No executable official pipeline or generated stream is available, and the repository's prospective release plan should not be treated as an artifact.

对于 Data Construction and Open Release Recipes track，R-Diverse 提供了一套跨轮多样性审计 recipe，而不只是在当前 batch 内去重。它把持久记忆放在三个构造位置：感知历史的 Challenger penalty、多样性测量的检索表面，以及 Solver training 的 replay 来源。该工作也说明，新颖性表示与正确性验证必须分开审计。

可审计实现应保留每个问题、全部 Solver rollout、提取和规范化后的答案、等价组、consistency、伪标签来源、canonical code、canonicalizer 与 embedding revision、最大和平均历史相似度、阈值判定、记忆插入/纠正/删除事件、replay provenance、各项 reward、random seed、policy checkpoint 与评估结果。被拒、异常和纠正过的记录也应可见，而不是被静默删除。

构建者可把该论文用作跨迭代去重、curriculum replay 或数据选择消融的 baseline。用于训练前，应加入独立 correctness check；以人工、符号或可执行判断校准 SAM；版本化 memory snapshot；限制或索引检索成本；执行 contamination 检查与多随机种子实验；并把 benchmark outcome 与训练记录标签分开保存。

当前复用边界是阅读 recipe 和独立重实现，而不是直接复用 dataset。官方没有提供可执行 pipeline 或生成数据流，仓库中的未来 release plan 也不能视为已经存在的 artifact。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html:
• Read §3 first and separate the evolving data object from final benchmark scores: questions, rollouts, pseudo-labels, code embeddings, memory decisions, and replay links are the construction record.
  • Keep three feedback roles distinct: uncertainty targets difficulty, SAM/MAP shape novelty, and majority pseudo-labels train the Solver.
  • SAM canonical code is a similarity representation. It is not executed proof, and its prompt may repair a flawed question into a different task.
  • Table 2 is the cleanest component check; the full 4B method scores 52.59 Math AVG versus 49.62 without MAP, 51.18 without replay, and 50.50 without SAM.
  • Treat Table 1 gains and GPT-4o analyses as evidence for the reported setup, not proof that individual records are correct or released.
  • Check the official repository before reuse: as of 2026-07-22 it is a non-executable project page with a prospective release plan.

• 先读 §3，并把演化中的数据对象与最终 benchmark 分数分开：问题、rollout、伪标签、代码 embedding、记忆判定和 replay link 才是构造记录。
  • 区分三种反馈角色：uncertainty 选择难度，SAM/MAP 塑造新颖性，多数投票伪标签训练 Solver。
  • SAM canonical code 只是相似度表示，不是执行证明；其 prompt 还可能把有缺陷的问题修复成另一个任务。
  • Table 2 是最直接的组件核验：完整 4B 方法 Math AVG 为 52.59，去除 MAP、replay、SAM 后分别为 49.62、51.18、50.50。
  • Table 1 增益与 GPT-4o 分析只支持论文报告的设置，不能证明单条记录正确或已经发布。
  • 复用前检查官方仓库：截至 2026-07-22，它仍是带未来发布计划的非可执行项目页。

value.html: Self-generated competition-mathematics questions. The Challenger prompt is disclosed, but no seed training corpus or fixed prompt pool is reported.

value.html: A generated question, multiple Solver reasoning responses and extracted final answers, answer-equivalence groups, consistency, a majority pseudo-label, canonical Python solver code, its embedding, historical similarities, memory membership, and replay provenance.

value_zh.html: 生成的问题、多条 Solver 推理响应与提取的最终答案、答案等价组、一致性、多数伪标签、规范 Python solver 代码、其嵌入、历史相似度、记忆成员资格与回放出处。

value.html: Qwen3 Challenger and Solver roles co-evolve. Qwen2.5-Coder-7B and Jina-Code-Embeddings-1.5B create the skill-similarity representation.

value_zh.html: Qwen3 Challenger 与 Solver 角色共同演化。Qwen2.5-Coder-7B 与 Jina-Code-Embeddings-1.5B 创建技能相似度表示。

value.html: EasyR1 implementation of an R-Zero-style alternating Challenger-Solver GRPO loop with persistent cross-iteration memory.

value_zh.html: EasyR1 实现对 R-Zero 风格交替 Challenger-Solver GRPO 循环，带持久跨迭代记忆。

value.html: Challenger reward combines Solver uncertainty with within-iteration and history-aware skill-similarity penalties. Solver reward is a binary match to a self-generated majority pseudo-label. GPT-4o is used for paper analyses and a disclosed answer-check prompt, but its exact training-time coverage is unknown.

value_zh.html: Challenger 奖励将 Solver 不确定性与迭代内及历史感知的技能相似度惩罚结合。Solver 奖励是与自生成多数伪标签的二元匹配。GPT-4o 用于论文分析与已披露的答案检查提示，但其确切训练时覆盖未知。

value.html: The reported study stops after five evolution iterations. Each rollout receives its scalar reward within the current optimization phase; valid questions may enter persistent memory, and 30 percent historical replay is mixed into Solver training. A natural convergence or memory termination rule is not disclosed.

value_zh.html: 所报告研究在五次演化迭代后停止。每次 rollout 在当前优化阶段内获得其标量奖励；有效问题可进入持久记忆，并将 30 percent 历史回放混入 Solver 训练。自然收敛或记忆终止规则未披露。

value.html: Qwen3-4B-Base and Qwen3-8B-Base

value_zh.html: Qwen3-4B-Base 与 Qwen3-8B-Base

value.html: No external answer teacher is reported for the primary training loop; the previous Solver supplies majority pseudo-labels. GPT-4o supplies analysis labels and judge-based checks.

value_zh.html: 主训练循环未报告外部答案教师；先前 Solver 提供多数伪标签。GPT-4o 提供分析标签与基于评审的检查。

value.html: A competition-mathematics Challenger alternates with a Solver for five evolution iterations, with 5 Challenger and 15 Solver optimization steps per iteration.

value_zh.html: 竞赛数学 Challenger 与 Solver 交替进行五次演化迭代，每次迭代含 5 个 Challenger 与 15 个 Solver 优化步。

value.html: Challenger training uses 4 rollouts and Solver training uses 5, both at temperature 1.0 and top-p 0.99. Canonical code generation uses temperature 0.

value_zh.html: Challenger 训练使用 4 次 rollouts，Solver 训练使用 5 次，均为 temperature 1.0 与 top-p 0.99。规范代码生成使用 temperature 0。

value.html: Questions that satisfy the uncertainty criterion may enter memory; the paper illustrates the valid range as consistency 0.3 to 0.8. Exact answer normalization, equivalence grouping, tie handling, and malformed-output policy are unknown.

value_zh.html: 满足不确定性准则的问题可进入记忆；论文将有效范围示为一致性 0.3 至 0.8。确切答案归一化、等价分组、平局处理与畸形输出策略未知。

value.html: Eight NVIDIA H20 GPUs with BF16 and FlashAttention 2. One Qwen3-4B evolution iteration is reported at about 6 hours; total token use, total run cost, and 8B timing are unknown.

value.html: GRPO with global batch size 128, learning rate 1e-6, weight decay 1e-2, KL coefficient 1e-2, MAP weights alpha=1 and beta=1, max-mean mixing gamma=0.5, similarity thresholds 0.5 and 0.25, and replay ratio 0.3.

value.html: Current self-generated competition-math questions plus historical replay. The paper does not publish per-iteration record counts or memory snapshots.

items: Majority pseudo-labels can be confidently wrong, and replay can preserve those errors.
The SAM canonicalizer may change the intended task because its prompt tells the model to repair ambiguous or flawed inputs.
Generated canonical code is not reported as being executed; code-embedding similarity is an uncalibrated proxy for reasoning-skill equivalence.
Answer normalization, equivalence grouping, memory correction and eviction, contamination controls, random seeds, and repeated-run variance are undisclosed.
The official repository contains a README and figures but no executable pipeline, weights, generated records, or tagged release.
多数伪标签可以自信地错误，回放可保留那些错误。
SAM 规范化器可能改变预期任务，因为其提示告诉模型修复歧义或有缺陷的输入。
未报告所生成规范代码被执行；代码嵌入相似度是推理技能等价的未校准代理。
答案归一化、等价分组、记忆校正与驱逐、污染控制、随机 seeds 与重复运行方差未披露。
官方仓库含 README 与图表，但无可执行流水线、权重、生成记录或带标签 release。

value.html: Challenger question -> Solver rollouts -> extracted answer groups -> consistency and majority pseudo-label -> canonical code and embedding -> novelty penalties and memory decision -> current or replay Solver update. No public record-level ledger, generated records, memory snapshots, or checkpoints instantiate this lineage.
